About SLCheck

Physician Tool

Instant Swiss SL lookup by drug, ATC, GTIN, condition or symptom. Full BAG/FOPH data — 10,405 medications, extract of 13 August 2026.

Features

★ Co-pay Calculator with franchise selector
★ Limitation Checklist — tick criteria before prescribing
★ Annual Savings — CHF saved per year switching to generic
★ Favourites — save your most-prescribed drugs
★ Therapeutically equivalent drugs by ATC group
★ All 4 Swiss languages (DE, FR, IT, EN)

Data source

Swiss Spezialitätenliste (BAG/FOPH), extract of 13 August 2026. Snapshot only — SL prices change monthly. Always verify at sl.bag.admin.ch before prescribing.
